title: ze_FFXII_Mt_Bur_Omisace_v6
description:
Map created by Ma/l/go, and ported by Waffel 

ze_FFXII_Mt_Bur_Omisace_v6

 This map is made for Zombie Escape. To properly play this map, you will need the necessary plugins from Source2ZE, which are available at their GitHub 

- Information :
For years, the Kiltia have lived here, practicing their faith,
and accepting refugees from all over Ivalice, giving them food and shelter.
Pilgrims will also make a spiritual trip to the mountain, in hopes of becoming more enlightened.
However, in these times of war, the mountain has seen more refugees than pilgrims,
and people who have lost their homes now live on the steep slope leading up to the temple.

 Map contains 5 Stages :
- Normal Mode
- Hard Mode
- Ultimate Mode
- Legend Mode
- ZM Mode
